name: FreeSWITCH
what_it_is: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack that enables the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a versatile software implementation, running on hardware ranging from Raspberry Pi to enterprise servers.
components: ESL (Event Socket Library) for external control
Module loader (dynamically loadable codec, endpoint, and application modules)
measurement: Event Socket interface exposes real-time call events and statistics
CDR (Call Detail Records) via mod_cdr_csv and mod_cdr_sqlite
configuration: Dialplan configured via XML or Lua/JavaScript scripts
Module configuration via individual XML files per module
Runtime reconfiguration via ESL (Event Socket Library) commands
modes: B2BUA (Back-to-Back User Agent) — default SIP mode
IVR (Interactive Voice Response) mode via mod_dptools
constraints: No docker-compose.yml present in the repository (neither main nor master branch) — containerization requires user-supplied Dockerfiles
Windows support is available but lags behind Linux in feature parity and community testing
mod_signalwire requires a SignalWire account token for cloud connectivity features
notable_absences: No built-in fault injection or chaos testing tooling
README does not document measurement/observability beyond ESL and CDR references
No native Kubernetes/Helm manifests in the repository
